name: Vine icon
description: UI slot for the vine. Composes `ss.proj.vine` through `use`, so the slot shows the coil the weapon actually lays rather than a second drawing of one that can drift from it. A patch of `$soil` sits under it and nothing else: the coil is already ground, and the earlier version of this slot pressed a ground *line* across the tile because the plant it held stood up out of a hole. Nothing stands up any more. The plant is composed at its `slot` ramp — the same drawing one step up on each of its three colours — because a 32px slot and a sprite on the field are lit for different jobs, and the cord that keeps out of a crowd's way goes to mud at a tenth of the area. The plate under it comes up a step too, `$coal` over `$coal.dark`, which is as far as it can go before it starts taking contrast back off the cord. Tile is `$sage`. It was `$moss`, which is the cord's own green and was chosen for that, and laid out beside the other seven weapon slots it was the one dark square in a row of bright ones — the vine did not read as a weapon with a colour, it read as the slot that had not been finished. `$sage` is the same hue lifted to where the row lives, far enough from the Spit's bile and the Chirp's frost to tell them apart at a glance, and far enough from the Spit's bile and the Lash's husk to tell the row apart at a glance, while everything drawn on it is the dark end of the same colour.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin, derived rather than drawn again. It takes the plant's own evolved variant with it, so the slot shows the gilded wood the evolved weapon actually grows.
